stack_method: Parse the callgraph by indentation; sum selected disjoint same-symbol subtrees and compute leaf residence as node count minus direct-child counts. Main and selected-thread leaf totals exactly match their root observation count. Recursive generic renderer symbols are not aggregated. Sample top-of-stack global totals are not interpreted asCPU.
wait_classification: Explicit semaphore/condition/kevent/Mach IPC boundary labels distinguish waiting/IPC from other captured leaves. Other leaves are NOT guaranteedCPU-active; IPC can include kernel work. Requested1ms does not mean1000 actual observations persecond.
